claims.claim: The 2026 federal budget earmarks $3 billion for the Massey Tunnel replacement project and millions for flood mitigation in B.C.
claims.episode_span: three billion dollars for the Massey Tunnel replacement project and millions for flood mitigation
claims.source_title: What the 2026 federal budget promises for B.C.
claims.supporting_quote: The 2026 federal budget earmarks several initiatives specifically for B.C., including $3 billion for the Massey Tunnel replacement project and millions for flood mitigation.

claims.claim: Vancouver landlords were fined $90,000 after dividing a home into 21 rooms for 17 tenants, and the Residential Tenancy Branch found they did not maintain the property to health, safety and housing standards.
claims.episode_span: fined Vancouver landlords ninety thousand dollars after they divided a home into twenty-one rooms for seventeen tenants
claims.source_title: Vancouver landlords fined $90K after dividing home into 21 rooms for 17 tenants
claims.supporting_quote: Following an investigation, the Residential Tenancy Branch found the landlords did not maintain the rental property in compliance with health, safety and housing standards.

claims.claim: Elections B.C. has begun the final count and said there are about 150,000 mail-in ballots to tally, plus absentee and assisted phone ballots.
claims.episode_span: about one hundred and fifty thousand mail-in ballots to tally, in addition to absentee and assisted phone ballots
claims.source_title: Elections B.C. begins final count after provincial election, some ridings still in balance
claims.supporting_quote: Elections B.C. said there are about 150,000 mail-in ballots to tally, in addition to absentee and assisted phone ballots that will be included in the final count.

claims.claim: The B.C. Centre for Long COVID reduced treatment options after MSP changes came into force November 1, and a Nanaimo teenager is among those losing access.
claims.episode_span: reduced treatment options after changes to the Medical Services Plan came into force on November 1
claims.source_title: B.C. program for kids with long COVID scales back services after changes to MSP
claims.supporting_quote: A Nanaimo teenager is among those losing access to support they say has changed their life. The B.C. Centre for Long COVID reduced treatment options after changes to MSP came into force November 1.

claims.claim: Pete Fry is Vancouver's mayor-elect and the city's first Green mayor; he was born in Dublin in 1969.
claims.episode_span: Pete Fry is Vancouver’s mayor-elect and the city’s first Green mayor
claims.source_title: The life of Fry: A portrait of the artist and activist who became mayor of Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Just a week earlier, at an election-night party just a few blocks away from this spot, Fry was celebrating his big win as Vancouver’s first Green mayor.

claims.claim: Jennifer Lynn Stephens was sentenced to 13 years in a sex trafficking case whose victims included several adults and a 13-year-old girl.
claims.episode_span: Jennifer Lynn Stephens has been sentenced to thirteen years in prison in a sex trafficking case
claims.source_title: B.C. woman sentenced to 13 years in prison in sex trafficking case
claims.supporting_quote: The human trafficking victims of Jennifer Lynn Stephens included several adults, as well as a 13-year-old girl who had already been the victim of sex trafficking.

claims.claim: Disposal of a small camper in B.C. typically costs about $1,000 and large trailers can cost several thousand dollars, according to Phil Pires.
claims.episode_span: Disposal of a small camper, including the kind that fits on the back of a truck, typically runs about one thousand dollars.
claims.source_title: It can cost thousands to get rid of an old RV in B.C., so people are dumping them
claims.supporting_quote: Disposal of a small camper, including the kind that fits on the back of a truck, typically runs about $1,000. Large trailers can cost several thousand dollars.

claims.claim: The City of Abbotsford said bylaw officers responded to four reports of abandoned vehicles in the last year, including two RVs, a trailer and a boat.
claims.episode_span: bylaw officers responded to four reports of abandoned vehicles in the last year, including two RVs, a trailer and a boat
claims.source_title: It can cost thousands to get rid of an old RV in B.C., so people are dumping them
claims.supporting_quote: In a statement, the City of Abbotsford said its bylaw officers responded to four reports of abandoned vehicles in the last year, including two RVs, a trailer and a boat.

claims.claim: The Winnipeg Jets beat the Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Thursday before 13,312 at Canada Life Centre, and Vancouver fell to 3-14-1.
claims.episode_span: The Winnipeg Jets beat the Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Thursday night before 13,312 at Canada Life Centre
claims.source_title: Jets carry momentum from ‘Miracle in Montreal’ to dominate Canucks
claims.supporting_quote: The Jets scored two goals in the first four minutes of the game and never looked back in a 6-2 victory over the Canucks before 13,312 at Canada Life Centre.

claims.claim: Dawson Mercer scored his first Winnipeg goal and an assist; Stuart Skinner made 24 saves; Brock Boeser and Liam Ohgren scored; Leevi Merilainen stopped 23 of 29 shots.
claims.episode_span: Dawson Mercer scored his first goal as a Jet and added an assist
claims.source_title: Mercer scores his first goal for Winnipeg in Jets' 6-2 victory over Canucks
claims.supporting_quote: Dawson Mercer scored his first goal for Winnipeg and added an assist in the Jets' 6-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

claims.claim: Highway 1 in Burnaby near the Kensington Avenue underpass is reduced to one lane after a vehicle incident, and Highway 7B at Shaughnessy Street in Port Coquitlam has the right lane blocked.
claims.episode_span: reduced to one lane, with delays expected
claims.source_title: DriveBC: 8 major road events in Metro Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Vehicle incident at Highway 1, In Burnaby and 12m North of Kensington Avenue Underpass. Reduced to one lane. Expect delays.

claims.claim: Friday's Vancouver forecast is rain of 15 to 25 mm, southeast wind 30 km/h gusting to 50 and to 70 near the Strait of Georgia, high 12, with no watches or warnings in effect.
claims.episode_span: Friday is rain, 15 to 25 millimetres, with a southeast wind of 30 km/h gusting to 50
claims.supporting_quote: Friday: Rain. Amount 15 to 25 mm. Wind southeast 30 km/h gusting to 50 except gusting to 70 near the Strait of Georgia this morning and early this afternoon. High 12.

claims.claim: WinterFest at the Museum of Surrey runs November 21 to December 20 with free entrance.
claims.episode_span: WinterFest at the Museum of Surrey, 17710 56A Avenue, runs from November 21 to December 20 with free entrance
claims.source_title: Museum of Surrey to host WinterFest again
claims.supporting_quote: WinterFest opens Nov. 21 and runs until Dec. 20 at the Museum of Surrey, 17710 56A Avenue. Entrance is free.
